name: EdgeDesk men's college basketball pregame forecast (adjusted efficiency, coherent score distribution)
hypothesis: Opponent-adjusted efficiency and tempo ratings from box scores (the research engine, basketball/ncaam_research/team_model.js, run over 2010+ hoopR box scores with parameters chosen on 2012-2019), turned into ONE discrete regulation-margin distribution with a fitted endgame tie factor and an overtime model, give calibrated win probabilities, margins and totals that beat the served scores-only points model as served.
objective: Calibrated pregame probabilities and score distributions for every NCAA Division I men's game, as research; never a recommendation.
primary_metric: Log loss of the home-win probability on D1-v-D1 games of the PROSPECTIVE 2026-27 season (each forecast published before tip and logged immutably), probabilities clipped to [1e-6, 1 - 1e-6]; margin CRPS on the integer grid second.
unit: One game. Games on one day share conditions: every interval is a game-day cluster bootstrap.
baseline: The served scores-only points model (edgedesk_bb_points_v1, docs/model-loop/ncaam/versions.json) as served, on the same games; and, once captured, same-time pregame market prices.
training_window: Ratings walk forward from 2010; hyperparameters chosen on 2012-2019 only (config/selection_v1.json); calibration refitted weekly on earlier games inside every walk.
validation_window: Confirmation 2020-2026 (validation/ncaam_fc_validation.json), retrospective: results were retrieved after the fact and assumed known 4 hours after tip. Descriptive for this registration: those seasons were also used by the operational promotion gates.
holdout_window: The 2026-27 season (2027), scored once after the national championship from the forecasts EdgeDesk published before each tip; the NCAA tournament games of 2024-2026 remain a separate historical tournament holdout.

machine.window_note: [from, to): dates of the seasons inside each window

minimum_sample.note: Below 4,000 prospectively logged D1-v-D1 forecasts the record is descriptive and no result row is written. The market criterion needs same-time quotes EdgeDesk captured itself; none exist for NCAAM before 2026-27, so until enough are captured it is NOT EVALUABLE and the model cannot pass.

promotion_criteria.decision_rule: passed = true only if every criterion holds on the prospective holdout. A criterion that cannot be evaluated is not met. Passing makes the model eligible; a person promotes it through a validation report. The weekly operational champion pointer is NOT a research result.

criteria.rule: Prospective D1-v-D1 log loss below the incumbent as served on the same games, game-day cluster bootstrap 95% upper bound of the difference below 0.

Logistic recalibration slope within [0.9, 1.1], calibration-in-the-large within 0.015, 80% margin and total interval coverage within [0.77, 0.83], every probability decile with n >= 100 within 0.04 of its observed rate.

Log loss below the same-time market reference (fair two-way price from a quote captured within 60 minutes before the forecast) on >= 1,000 matched games, interval below 0. Closing prices are reported separately and cannot satisfy this criterion.
On the prospective NCAA tournament games, log loss no worse than the incumbent's by more than 0.01 (reported with its interval; 67 games are little evidence).

promotion_criteria.family_correction: All four are required (an intersection test); no criterion is reported as a pass on its own.

candidates_tried.ratings: research engine, coordinate descent over 6 parameters + 2 tempo parameters on 2012-2019 (about 30 configurations)
candidates_tried.evaluated_against_outcomes: development 2012-2019 for every choice; confirmation 2020-2026 scored after the choice

candidates_tried.ratings: margin variance s0 + k v (stabilised parameter variance) vs a pace/spread law; total variance with the pace term

the calibrator's location, spread and kappa solved jointly so the model's own tie-compressed regulation margin matches the data (dist.js fit, location_fit 'tie_consistent'); found by a synthetic-recovery unit test, not by outcomes
candidates_tried.evaluated_against_outcomes: operational weekly gate on 2020-2026 (reports/weekly/2026-10-23-tie_consistent_fit.json): log loss -0.00008 [-0.00012, -0.00004], slope 1.046 -> 1.038; RETAIN (below the frozen -0.0002 threshold). The registered version keeps the plain fit.

alternatives_considered_not_tried: a Student-t regulation margin (the coherent-slope gain is bounded at 0.0004 log loss by a dev-fitted recalibration)
roster-continuity and transfer priors (no roster data before 2024)
possession-level simulation (validated possession data exists for 2025-26 only)
forking_paths.data_already_seen: 2010-2026 results and box scores; the 2026-27 season has not started (first game 2026-11-02).
forking_paths.stopping_rule: Fixed horizon: the 2026-27 season is scored once after the championship game.

spec.distribution: basketball/ncaam_forecast/dist.js (regulation PMF, endgame factor kappa, overtime periods, total mixture)
known_limitations: no player availability or lineup input
retrospective validation: no historical first-publication times
no market comparison until NCAAM quotes are captured
margin kurtosis about 3.3: a normal regulation margin leaves probabilities slightly too timid (slope 1.04-1.07)

the plain calibrator fit reads the tie-compressed regulation margin as the location (about 4% attenuation near even games); the corrected fit is a catalogue challenger that the frozen gate has not promoted
